# Parallel sessions add files instead of editing shared lists

**Decision:** changelog entries and migration notes are per-PR fragments in `changes/`, folded by `rust-ui changelog` before a release; the kit's module, prelude, demo and test lists are generated by `crates/ui/build.rs`; new platform notes and decisions are one file each; `scripts/sync-main.sh` merges main and regenerates generated files; `scripts/check.sh` fails when a branch is behind main or edits `CHANGELOG.md`/`docs/MIGRATION.md`.

**Why:** after PR #40 merged on 2026-10-15, all four other open PRs conflicted, every one of them in `CHANGELOG.md`, and one also in the test lists. Across PRs #17 to #40 the files edited on both sides of a merge were `docs/GUARDRAILS.md` (12 merges), `tests/render.rs` and `Cargo.lock` (7), `scripts/check.sh` (6), and the module and demo lists. Rules alone ("sync often") had not prevented it; removing the shared lines does.

**Asked for by:** the owner ("can we make a process that this does not repeat when working with multiple sessions").
